title: Friendship is Magic, part 1
summary: Friendship is Magic, part 1 is the first episode of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic, which premiered to coincide with the debut of its airing television channel The Hub. The episode is referred to as Mare in the Moon, another title for Nightmare Moon, on Hasbro's viewing guide and The Magic of Friendship, part 1 in The Elements of Harmony guidebook. It is the first half of a two-part episode.

Princess Celestia sends her student Twilight Sparkle to supervise the preparations for the Summer Sun Celebration in Ponyville. Twilight is concerned that the celebration will instead bring about the return of Nightmare Moon, though her efforts to investigate are continually interrupted by ponies trying to befriend her.

title: Friendship is Magic, part 2
summary: Friendship is Magic, part 2 is the second episode of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. The episode is referred to as Elements of Harmony on Hasbro's viewing guide[2] and The Magic of Friendship, part 2 in The Elements of Harmony guidebook. It is the second half of a two-part episode.
Twilight Sparkle and her new friends travel to the Castle of the Two Sisters to retrieve the Elements of Harmony in the hope of stopping Nightmare Moon from taking over Equestria.

title: The Ticket Master
summary: The Ticket Master is the third episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, Princess Celestia gives Twilight Sparkle two tickets to the Grand Galloping Gala, but her five friends want to attend.

title: Applebuck Season
summary: Applebuck Season is the fourth episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, Applejack attempts to harvest the apple crop in Sweet Apple Acres by herself because her brother, Big McIntosh, is injured. However, her stubbornness and sleep deprivation cause problems all over Ponyville.

title: Griffon the Brush Off
summary: Griffon the Brush Off is the fifth episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, Pinkie Pie and Rainbow Dash bond by playing pranks on the other ponies, but when Rainbow's old friend Gilda the griffon shows up for a visit, Pinkie feels left out. The title is a play on the phrase "given the brush-off", which is an abrupt and rude dismissal.

title: Boast Busters
summary: Boast Busters is the sixth episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, a new unicorn going by the name of "The Great and Powerful Trixie" arrives in Ponyville claiming to be the greatest unicorn in all of Equestria. The title of the episode is a play on the title of the Ghostbusters franchise.

title: Dragonshy
summary: Dragonshy is the seventh episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, the smoke of a sleeping dragon disrupts the skies of Equestria, and the Mane Six are tasked with convincing it to leave, much to Fluttershy's dismay. The episode's title is a portmanteau of "dragon" and "Fluttershy".

title: Look Before You Sleep
summary: Look Before You Sleep is the eighth episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, a thunderstorm forces Applejack and Rarity to stay the night at Twilight Sparkle's residence in the Golden Oak Library, where Twilight takes the opportunity to host a slumber party. The title of the episode is a play on the saying "look before you leap", meaning to act only after careful planning.

title: Bridle Gossip
summary: Bridle Gossip is the ninth episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, Twilight Sparkle and her friends encounter Zecora, a mysterious zebra who lives in the Everfree Forest. The title of the episode is a play on the phrase "idle gossip".

title: Swarm of the Century
summary: Swarm of the Century is the tenth episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, a swarm of pests called parasprites find their way into Ponyville, causing chaos and threatening to ruin Princess Celestia's visit to the town.

title: Winter Wrap Up
summary: Winter Wrap Up is the eleventh episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, Twilight Sparkle wants to participate in Ponyville's annual winter clean-up but struggles to find a suitable role.

title: Call of the Cutie
summary: Call of the Cutie is the twelfth episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, Apple Bloom becomes concerned about her lack of a cutie mark and tries to earn it before an upcoming party.

title: Fall Weather Friends
summary: Fall Weather Friends is the thirteenth episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, Applejack and Rainbow Dash's sportsmanship is put to the test as they face off in a series of competitions to see who the better athlete is. The title is a play on "fair weather friends", which refers to people who are only friends when it is convenient (when weather is fair) and will abandon their friends during bad times.

title: Suited For Success
summary: Suited For Success is the fourteenth episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, Rarity wants to make dresses for her friends for the upcoming Grand Galloping Gala but has trouble satisfying all their requests. The title of the episode is a play on the phrase "dressed for success".

title: Feeling Pinkie Keen
summary: Feeling Pinkie Keen is the fifteenth episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, Twilight Sparkle learns that Pinkie Pie has an unusual ability to sense happenings in the immediate future known as "Pinkie Sense." The title of the episode is a play on the phrase "feeling peachy keen," which refers to feeling upbeat and generally happy.

title: Sonic Rainboom
summary: Sonic Rainboom is the sixteenth episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, Rainbow Dash becomes anxious about performing a sonic rainboom in the Best Young Flyer competition.

title: Stare Master
summary: Stare Master is the seventeenth episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, Fluttershy offers to host a sleepover for the Cutie Mark Crusaders but soon questions whether she bit off more than she can chew. The episode's title is a play on StairMaster, an American exercise machine company.

title: The Show Stoppers
summary: The Show Stoppers is the eighteenth episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, the Cutie Mark Crusaders perform in a school talent show in an effort to earn their cutie marks. The title refers to the term "showstopper", which is either a performance that garners enthusiastic or prolonged applause or an action or event that puts a halt to all other activities.

title: A Dog and Pony Show
summary: A Dog and Pony Show is the nineteenth episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, Rarity gets abducted by the Diamond Dogs while out searching for gems, leading Spike and the other ponies to come to her aid. The term "dog and pony show" refers to an overly performative presentation.

title: Green Isn't Your Color
summary: Green Isn't Your Color is the twentieth episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, Rarity becomes jealous when Fluttershy is picked to be a fashion model instead of her, though Fluttershy secretly loathes the role.

title: Over a Barrel
summary: Over a Barrel is the twenty-first episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, Spike and the Mane Six head to the frontier town of Appleloosa and find themselves caught in a dispute between the settler ponies and the native buffalo herd. The idiom "over a barrel" means being in a helpless position where others are in control.

title: A Bird in the Hoof
summary: A Bird in the Hoof is the twenty-second episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, Fluttershy tries to nurse Princess Celestia's pet bird back to health but faces unexpected challenges. The episode title references the proverb "a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush," which means it is better to possess a certain benefit than risk losing it for something better.

title: The Cutie Mark Chronicles
summary: The Cutie Mark Chronicles is the twenty-third episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, the Cutie Mark Crusaders learn how each of the Mane Six acquired their cutie marks.

title: Owl's Well That Ends Well
summary: Owl's Well That Ends Well is the twenty-fourth episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, Spike grows jealous when Twilight Sparkle befriends an owl and appoints it as a second personal assistant. The title of the episode is a play on the phrase "all's well that ends well."

title: Party of One
summary: Party of One is the twenty-fifth episode of the first season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, Pinkie Pie invites her friends to a party but grows suspicious when everyone claims they are too busy to attend.

title: The Best Night Ever
summary: The Best Night Ever is the twenty-sixth and final episode of season one of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. In this episode, Twilight Sparkle and her friends attend the Grand Galloping Gala but are disappointed when none of their expectations are met.

title: The Return of Harmony Part 1
summary: The Return of Harmony Part 1 is the first episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the twenty-seventh episode overall. It is the first part of a two-part episode.

When strange phenomena start occurring across Equestria, Princess Celestia tasks the Mane Six with wielding the Elements of Harmony to defeat Discord, though they must first contend with his manipulation tactics.

title: The Return of Harmony Part 2
summary: The Return of Harmony Part 2 is the second episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the twenty-eighth episode overall. It is the second half of a two-part episode.

After failing to locate the Elements of Harmony in the palace labyrinth, Twilight Sparkle redoubles her search but faces new difficulties from her friends, whose personalities have been altered by Discord.

title: Lesson Zero
summary: Lesson Zero is the third episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the twenty-ninth episode overall. In this episode, Twilight Sparkle realizes she has not sent a weekly friendship report to Princess Celestia in almost a week and tries to find a friendship problem to write about.

title: Luna Eclipsed
summary: Luna Eclipsed is the fourth episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the thirtieth episode overall. In this episode, Twilight Sparkle tries to help Princess Luna appreciate the traditions of Ponyville's annual Nightmare Night, though its roots in the stories of Nightmare Moon complicate her effort. The episode's title is a play on the term "lunar eclipse", an astronomical event wherein the Moon passes through the Earth's shadow.
The Nightmare Night festival featured in this episode is analogous to modern-day observances of Halloween.

title: Sisterhooves Social
summary: Sisterhooves Social is the fifth episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the thirty-first episode overall. In this episode, Sweetie Belle wants to participate in the Sisterhooves Social just as she and Rarity face a crisis in their relationship. The titular term "sisterhooves" is a portmanteau of "sisterhood" and "hooves".

title: The Cutie Pox
summary: The Cutie Pox is the sixth episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the thirty-second episode overall. In this episode, Apple Bloom grows impatient for her cutie mark and finds a way to get one immediately, only to end up with more than she bargained for. The term pox is used to describe a variety diseases characterized by pockmarks, and in the archaic sense, it may refer to disease in general.

title: May the Best Pet Win!
summary: May the Best Pet Win! is the seventh episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the thirty-third episode overall. In this episode, Rainbow Dash wants to own a pet like her friends do and decides to hold a competition to determine which animal she should pick. The episode title is a play on the idiom "may the best man win".

title: The Mysterious Mare Do Well
summary: The Mysterious Mare Do Well is the eighth episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the thirty-fourth episode overall. In this episode, Rainbow Dash takes on a heroic persona when her acts of bravery garner positive attention, though she becomes jealous when a second hero appears and starts stealing the spotlight. "Mare Do Well" is a play on the term "ne'er-do-well," a person who is completely lacking in merit.

title: Sweet and Elite
summary: Sweet and Elite is the ninth episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the thirty-fifth episode overall. In this episode, Rarity visits Canterlot and ends up making friends with several elite figures in the city. When her Ponyville friends decide to host a birthday celebration at the same time as an exclusive garden party, however, Rarity must decide which one to attend.

title: Secret of My Excess
summary: Secret of My Excess is the tenth episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the thirty-sixth episode overall. In this episode, Spike lets his dragon greed get the best of him, which eventually causes him to grow to a monstrous size. The title is a reference to the 1987 film The Secret of My Success.

title: Hearth's Warming Eve
summary: Hearth's Warming Eve is the eleventh episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the thirty-seventh episode overall. In this episode, the Mane Six and Spike star in a pageant about the founding of Equestria.

title: Family Appreciation Day
summary: Family Appreciation Day is the twelfth episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the thirty-eighth episode overall. In this episode, Apple Bloom grows embarrassed with Granny Smith's mannerisms and tries to prevent her from presenting during the school's Family Appreciation Day.

title: Baby Cakes
summary: Baby Cakes is the thirteenth episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the thirty-ninth episode overall. In this episode, Pinkie Pie offers to babysit Mr. and Mrs. Cake's newborn twins, though the job turns out to be harder than she initially thought.

title: The Last Roundup
summary: The Last Roundup is the fourteenth episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the fortieth episode overall. In this episode, when Applejack refuses to return to Ponyville following a rodeo competition in Canterlot, her friends determine to find out what's going on.

title: The Super Speedy Cider Squeezy 6000
summary: The Super Speedy Cider Squeezy 6000 is the fifteenth episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the forty-first episode overall. In this episode, when Ponyville's high demand for apple cider exceeds the Apple family's capacity to produce it, a new competitor arrives in town to take their business.

title: Read It and Weep
summary: Read It and Weep is the sixteenth episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the forty-second episode overall. In this episode, Rainbow Dash discovers a love of reading during a hospital stay but tries to hide it for fear of being seen as an "egghead". The title is a play on the phrase "read 'em and weep", used to flaunt a particular victory or advantage over someone else.

title: Hearts and Hooves Day
summary: Hearts and Hooves Day is the seventeenth episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the forty-third episode overall. In this episode, the Cutie Mark Crusaders try to match Cheerilee with a "very special somepony" for Hearts and Hooves Day, though the potion they use to do so ends up creating an unexpected problem.
The Hearts and Hooves Day holiday featured in this episode is analogous to Valentine's Day.

title: A Friend in Deed
summary: A Friend in Deed is the eighteenth episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the forty-fourth episode overall. In this episode, Pinkie Pie tries to make friends with a new face in town, though her antics end up poorly received. The title is a word play on the saying "a friend in need is a friend indeed".

title: Putting Your Hoof Down
summary: Putting Your Hoof Down is the nineteenth episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the forty-fifth episode overall. In this episode, Fluttershy determines to stop being a "doormat" and attends a seminar course on assertiveness, though she ends up taking the lessons too far. The title is a play on the phrase "putting your foot down", meaning to insist on a particular course of action.

title: It's About Time
summary: It's About Time is the twentieth episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the forty-sixth episode overall. In this episode, Twilight Sparkle receives a warning about an unspecified event from her future self, though her attempts to prevent it only seem to draw it closer.

title: Dragon Quest
summary: Dragon Quest is the twenty-first episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the forty-seventh episode overall. In this episode, Spike decides to join the great dragon migration to discover his true identity.

title: Hurricane Fluttershy
summary: Hurricane Fluttershy is the twenty-second episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the forty-eighth episode overall. In this episode, Fluttershy is called on to help the Ponyville Pegasi create a tornado to lift water into Cloudsdale, though she must first face her insecurities as a flier.

title: Ponyville Confidential
summary: Ponyville Confidential is the twenty-third episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the forty-ninth episode overall. In this episode, the Cutie Mark Crusaders start producing a gossip column for the school newspaper in an effort to earn cutie marks in journalism, though their concession to the demand for slanderous material lands them in hot water.

title: MMMystery on the Friendship Express
summary: MMMystery on the Friendship Express is the twenty-fourth episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the fiftieth episode overall. In this episode, Pinkie Pie takes an overnight train to transport a cake to a dessert contest in Canterlot, but when it gets partially eaten during the night, she launches an investigation to find out the culprit. The title is a reference to the 1934 crime novel Murder on the Orient Express.

title: A Canterlot Wedding - Part 1
summary: A Canterlot Wedding - Part 1 is the twenty-fifth episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the fifty-first overall. It is the first half of a two-part season finale.

The Mane Six head to Canterlot to participate in the wedding of Twilight Sparkle's brother Shining Armor, though their sibling relationship becomes strained when Twilight begins accusing the bride of strange behavior.

title: A Canterlot Wedding - Part 2
summary: A Canterlot Wedding - Part 2 is the twenty-sixth episode of the second season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the fifty-second episode overall. It is the second episode in a two-part season finale.
After being imprisoned by an impostor, Twilight Sparkle finds the real Princess Cadance and sets out to stop the changelings from taking over Equestria.

title: The Crystal Empire - Part 1
summary: The Crystal Empire - Part 1 is the first episode of the third season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the fifty-third episode overall.[2] It is the first half of a two-part episode.
When a city suddenly appears in northern Equestria, Princess Celestia sends Twilight Sparkle to help Princess Cadance and Shining Armor protect the inhabitants from an ancient evil.

title: The Crystal Empire - Part 2
summary: The Crystal Empire - Part 2 is the second episode of the third season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the fifty-fourth episode overall. It is the second episode of a two-part season premier.
Twilight Sparkle and Spike search for the Crystal Heart while their friends try to distract the Crystal Ponies from the approach of King Sombra.

title: Too Many Pinkie Pies
summary: Too Many Pinkie Pies is the third episode of the third season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the fifty-fifth episode overall. In this episode, Pinkie Pie finds a way to clone herself so she can attend all of her friends' fun activities at the same time, only for the clones to wreck havoc across town.

title: One Bad Apple
summary: One Bad Apple is the fourth episode of the third season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the fifty-sixth episode overall. In this episode, Apple Bloom is excited for her cousin Babs Seed to visit Sweet Apple Acres, only for their relationship to fall apart when Diamond Tiara and Silver Spoon intervene. The title is a reference to the proverb "One bad apple spoils the bunch".

title: Magic Duel
summary: Magic Duel is the fifth episode of the third season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the fifty-seventh episode overall. In this episode, Trixie returns to Ponyville and wields a powerful artifact to get revenge on Twilight Sparkle.

title: Sleepless in Ponyville
summary: Sleepless in Ponyville is the sixth episode of the third season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the fifty-eighth episode overall. In this episode, Scootaloo tries to appear tough in front of Rainbow Dash during a camping trip but struggles to hide her fear when Rainbow starts telling campfire stories. The title is a reference to the film Sleepless in Seattle.

title: Wonderbolts Academy
summary: Wonderbolts Academy, called Wonderbolt Academy by some sources,[2] is the seventh episode of the third season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the fifty-ninth episode overall. In this episode, Rainbow Dash is accepted to the Wonderbolt Academy, but the stiff competition forces her to choose between standing out and respecting the other participants.

title: Apple Family Reunion
summary: Apple Family Reunion is the eighth episode of the third season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the sixtieth overall. In this episode, Applejack takes the lead in organizing an Apple family reunion, though her efforts to make the event memorable end up going too far.

title: Spike at Your Service
summary: Spike at Your Service is the ninth episode of the third season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the sixty-first episode overall. In this episode, Spike insists on serving Applejack for life after she rescues him from timberwolves, but Applejack has no interest in the arrangement.

title: Keep Calm and Flutter On
summary: Keep Calm and Flutter On is the tenth episode of the third season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the sixty-second episode overall. In this episode, Princess Celestia calls on Fluttershy to lead the Mane Six in the task of reforming Discord, though the friends disagree on the best approach. The title of the episode alludes to the 1939 British World War II motivational poster Keep Calm and Carry On.

title: Just for Sidekicks
summary: Just for Sidekicks is the eleventh episode of the third season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the sixty-third episode overall. In this episode, Spike convinces the Mane Six to let him care for their pets in exchange for gems while they travel to the Crystal Empire, though he quickly finds himself overwhelmed by the task. The title of the episode is a play on the phrase "just for kicks".

This episode and Games Ponies Play take place simultaneously; the former centers on Spike as he takes care of the main cast's pets, while the latter focuses on Twilight Sparkle and her friends welcoming the Equestria Games inspector to the Crystal Empire. At the very beginning of this episode, the camera pans by a series of photos showing that Peewee, the baby phoenix Spike saved in Dragon Quest, was returned to his parents.

title: Games Ponies Play
summary: Games Ponies Play is the twelfth episode of the third season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the sixty-fourth episode overall. In this episode, the Mane Six are called on to welcome the Equestria Games inspector to the Crystal Empire so that she will select the city to host the event. The episode title alludes to the 1964 bestselling book Games People Play.

This episode and Just for Sidekicks take place simultaneously; the former focuses on Twilight Sparkle and her friends trying to impress the Equestria Games inspector in the Crystal Empire, while the latter centers on Spike as he takes care of the main cast's pets.

title: Magical Mystery Cure
summary:
Magical Mystery Cure is the thirteenth episode of the third season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. It aired as the final episode of the third season and the sixty-fifth episode overall, and it takes place before the spin-off film My Little Pony Equestria Girls. The title alludes to the album Magical Mystery Tour by the Beatles.
In this episode, Twilight Sparkle accidentally switches her friends' destinies and tries to fix them, creating new magic in the process. As a result, Princess Celestia transforms her into an Alicorn and crowns her a princess.

This is one of four musical episodes; the others are Pinkie Pride, Crusaders of the Lost Mark, and A Hearth's Warming Tail.

title: Princess Twilight Sparkle - Part 1
summary: Princess Twilight Sparkle - Part 1 is the first episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the sixty-sixth episode overall. It is the first half of a two-part episode whose events take place after the spin-off film My Little Pony Equestria Girls.[2][3][4]

Princess Celestia and Princess Luna mysteriously disappear right before the new Summer Sun Celebration. As Twilight Sparkle attempts to figure out what happened to them, a fast-growing plant from the Everfree Forest begins attacking Ponyville.

title: Princess Twilight Sparkle - Part 2
summary: Princess Twilight Sparkle - Part 2 is the second episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the sixty-seventh episode overall. It is the second half of a two-part episode.
After Princess Celestia and Princess Luna go missing, Twilight Sparkle and her friends search the Everfree Forest for answers and eventually find the origin of the Elements of Harmony.

title: Castle Mane-ia
summary: Castle Mane-ia (written as Castle-Mania by some sources​[​citation needed​]​) is the third episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the sixty-eighth episode overall. In this episode, the Mane Six end up exploring the same old castle for different reasons and unwittingly scare each other silly in the process. The title of the episode is an allusion to the video game series Castlevania by Konami.[2]

title: Daring Don't
summary: Daring Don't is the fourth episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the sixty-ninth episode overall. In this episode, Rainbow Dash is dismayed to learn that the next Daring Do novel will be delayed, though upon offering to help move things along, she makes a shocking discovery about the author.

title: Flight to the Finish
summary: Flight to the Finish is the fifth episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the seventieth episode overall. In this episode, the Cutie Mark Crusaders enter a competition to carry the Ponyville flag at the Equestria Games, though Scootaloo worries that her performance is letting her friends down. The episode title is a play on the term "fight to the finish."

title: Power Ponies
summary: Power Ponies[note 1] is the sixth episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the seventy-first episode overall. In this episode, Spike and the Mane Six are sucked into a comic book world and must defeat a maniacal supervillain in order to escape.

title: Bats!
summary: Bats! is the seventh episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the seventy-second episode overall. In this episode, Applejack asks her friends to help stop an infestation of vampire fruit bats at Sweet Apple Acres, though they accidentally create a new apple-eating menace in the process. The title could be a pun on the interjection "rats", which expresses disappointment or frustration.

title: Rarity Takes Manehattan
summary: Rarity Takes Manehattan is the eighth episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the seventy-third episode overall. In this episode, Rarity finds her generous nature tested during a fashion competition in Manehattan. The name is either a reference to the 1984 movie The Muppets Take Manhattan or to Leonard Cohen's song "First We Take Manhattan", which specifically refers to the fashion industry; it is not a reference to the 1989 slasher film Jason Takes Manhattan.[3]

title: Pinkie Apple Pie
summary: Pinkie Apple Pie[3] (misspelled as Pinky Apple Pie in the opening credits, but fixed for Netflix) is the ninth episode of season four of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the seventy-fourth episode overall. In this episode, Pinkie Pie joins Applejack, Apple Bloom, Big McIntosh, and Granny Smith on a trip to find out whether or not she is Applejack's cousin.

title: Rainbow Falls
summary: Rainbow Falls is the tenth episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the seventy-fifth episode overall. In this episode, Rainbow Dash leads the Ponyville aerial relay team as they seek to qualify for the Equestria Games, though her loyalty is tested when the Wonderbolts invite her to join them on the Cloudsdale team.

title: Three's A Crowd
summary: Three's A Crowd is the eleventh episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the seventy-sixth episode overall. In this episode, an ill Discord interrupts Twilight Sparkle's quality bonding time with Princess Cadance. The title is a part of the proverb 'Two is company, three's a crowd,' meaning that a third person spoils the ideal combination of a couple.

title: Pinkie Pride
summary: Pinkie Pride is the twelfth episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the seventy-seventh episode overall. In this episode, Pinkie Pie is tasked with organizing Rainbow Dash's "birth-iversary", though the arrival of a second party thrower threatens to uproot both her plans and her reputation as Ponyville's premier party pony.
This is one of four musical episodes; the others are Magical Mystery Cure, Crusaders of the Lost Mark, and A Hearth's Warming Tail.

title: Simple Ways
summary: Simple Ways is the thirteenth episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the seventy-eighth episode overall. In this episode, Rarity tries to win the heart of a famous travel writer but learns that his romantic interests lie elsewhere.

title: Filli Vanilli
summary: Filli Vanilli is the fourteenth episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the seventy-ninth episode overall. In this episode, Fluttershy agrees to replace an ailing singer in the a cappella group headlining her animal charity event, though she must first find a way to deal with her stage fright. The title is a reference to the controversial German R&B group Milli Vanilli, whose lead singers were found to not only be lip-syncing in their concerts but also using other singers for their music releases.

title: Twilight Time
summary: Twilight Time is the fifteenth episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the eightieth episode overall. In this episode, the Cutie Mark Crusaders use their relationship with Equestria's newest princess to gain popularity at school.

title: It Ain't Easy Being Breezies
summary: It Ain't Easy Being Breezies is the sixteenth episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the eighty-first episode overall. In this episode, Fluttershy cares for a group of Breezies that lose their way while traveling home, though her hospitality nearly causes more harm than good. The title closely resembles the phrase "It ain't easy being cheesy", a misremembered version of the now defunct Cheetos slogan "It's not easy being cheesy".

title: Somepony to Watch Over Me
summary: Somepony to Watch Over Me is the seventeenth episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the eighty-second episode overall. In this episode, Apple Bloom becomes frustrated with Applejack's overprotective behavior and tries to prove that she doesn't need constant care. The title is a reference to the George Gershwin song "Someone to Watch Over Me".

title: Maud Pie
summary: Maud Pie is the eighteenth episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the eighty-third episode overall. In this episode, Pinkie Pie introduces the rest of the Mane Six to her older sister, but they have trouble finding common ground.

title: For Whom the Sweetie Belle Toils
summary: For Whom the Sweetie Belle Toils is the nineteenth episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the eighty-fourth episode overall. In this episode, Sweetie Belle mistakenly believes that Rarity is trying to outshine her and takes revenge. The title is a reference to a line from Devotions Upon Emergent Occasions by John Donne, which also serves as the basis for the title of Ernest Hemingway's novel For Whom the Bell Tolls.

title: Leap of Faith
summary: Leap of Faith is the twentieth episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the eighty-fifth episode overall. In this episode, Applejack becomes concerned when Granny Smith promotes a dubious miracle tonic sold by the Flim Flam brothers. The title of the episode is a reference to the phrase of the same name, meaning to accept an idea or conclusion largely on personal belief.

title: Testing Testing 1, 2, 3
summary: Testing Testing 1, 2, 3 (written as Testing, Testing, 1, 2, 3 in some sources) is the twenty-first episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the eighty-sixth episode overall. In this episode, Rainbow Dash's friends use various teaching methods to help her prepare for the Wonderbolts Reserves entrance exam. The title is a common phrase used to test the volume level of a microphone.

title: Trade Ya!
summary: Trade Ya! (written as Trade Ya in some sources) is the twenty-second episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the eighty-seventh episode overall. In this episode, the Mane Six spend a day at the Rainbow Falls Traders Exchange, though their original trade ambitions prove difficult to achieve.

title: Inspiration Manifestation
summary: Inspiration Manifestation is the twenty-third episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the eighty-eighth episode overall. In this episode, Spike fears that being honest with Rarity about her creative excess will ruin their friendship.

title: Equestria Games
summary: Equestria Games is the twenty-fourth episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the eighty-ninth episode overall. In this episode, Spike becomes discouraged when his attempts to contribute to the Equestria Games don't go as planned.

title: Twilight's Kingdom - Part 1
summary: Twilight's Kingdom - Part 1 is the twenty-fifth episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the ninetieth episode overall. It is the first half of a two-part season finale.
While Twilight Sparkle struggles for a sense of purpose as Equestria's newest princess, Princess Celestia calls on Discord to help track down a new villain who escaped from Tartarus.

title: Twilight's Kingdom - Part 2
summary: Twilight's Kingdom - Part 2 is the twenty-sixth episode of the fourth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the ninety-first episode overall. It is the second part of a two-part season finale and the last episode to take place before the film My Little Pony Equestria Girls: Rainbow Rocks.
Unable to stop Lord Tirek from taking control of Equestria, Princess Celestia, Princess Luna, and Princess Cadance entrust Twilight Sparkle with both their Alicorn magic and their hope of salvation.

title: The Cutie Map - Part 1
summary: The Cutie Map - Part 1, also formatted The Cutie Map, Part 1[1] and also called Cutie Markless[2] Pt 1,[3] is the first episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the ninety-second episode overall, being the first episode to take place after the film My Little Pony Equestria Girls: Rainbow Rocks. It is the first part of a two-part season premiere. Along with Part 2 of the premiere, these two are the first episodes to premiere on the Discovery Family Channel.

In this episode, Princess Twilight Sparkle and her friends unlock a magical map in her new castle, which leads them to a rather mysterious village where the inhabitants have given up their cutie marks.

title: The Cutie Map - Part 2
summary: The Cutie Map - Part 2, also formatted The Cutie Map, Part 2[1] and also called Cutie Markless[2][3] Pt 2,[4] is the second episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the ninety-third episode overall. It is the second part of a two-part season premiere. Along with Part 1 of the premiere, these two are the first episodes to premiere on the Discovery Family Channel.
In this episode, the Mane Six attempt to retrieve everyone's cutie marks as well as their own. In the process, they discover a startling secret about the pony who took them away.

title: Castle Sweet Castle
summary: Castle Sweet Castle is the third episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the ninety-fourth episode overall. The title is a play on the phrase "Home sweet home."
After finding out Princess Twilight's been avoiding her castle, her friends try to make it feel more like home.

title: Bloom & Gloom
summary:
Bloom & Gloom (spelled as Bloom and Gloom by some sources) is the fourth episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the ninety-fifth episode overall. The title is a play on the phrase "doom and gloom."
In this episode, Apple Bloom's anxiety over not having her cutie mark turns her life into a nightmare.

title: Tanks for the Memories
summary:
Tanks for the Memories is the fifth episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the ninety-sixth episode overall. The title is a play on the song "Thanks for the Memory" by Bob Hope and Shirley Ross; the title is not a reference to the Fall Out Boy song, nor is it a reference to The Big Broadcast of 1938.[1]
To prevent her pet tortoise Tank from going into hibernation, Rainbow Dash tries to stop winter from coming to Ponyville.

title: Appleoosa's Most Wanted
summary:
Appleoosa's[sic] Most Wanted is the sixth episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the ninety-seventh episode overall. The title is a parody of the reality series America's Most Wanted.
In this episode, the Cutie Mark Crusaders try to bring an infamous outlaw to justice in hopes of earning their cutie marks.

title: Make New Friends but Keep Discord
summary: Make New Friends but Keep Discord (spelled as Make New Friends But Keep Discord by some sources) is the seventh episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the ninety-eighth episode overall. The title is a play on the phrase "make new friends but keep the old."
When Discord learns that Fluttershy is taking a new friend to the Grand Galloping Gala instead of him, he goes to extreme lengths to prove that he isn't jealous.

title: The Lost Treasure of Griffonstone
summary: The Lost Treasure of Griffonstone is the eighth episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the ninety-ninth episode overall.
In this episode, Pinkie Pie and Rainbow Dash have conflicting ideas of fixing a problem after being called by the Cutie Map to the city of Griffonstone.

title: Slice of Life
summary: Slice of Life is the ninth episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the show's one-hundredth episode overall, celebrated as a milestone episode. The phrase "slice of life" refers to works of fiction that depict mundane everyday events.
While the Mane Six are busy battling a monster, the citizens of Ponyville try to get to a wedding on time.

title: Princess Spike
summary: Princess Spike is the tenth episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one-hundred and first episode overall.
In this episode, things go haywire when Spike starts making decisions under Princess Twilight's name.

title: Party Pooped
summary: Party Pooped is the eleventh episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and second episode overall.
After an important summit with visiting yaks goes wrong, Pinkie Pie embarks on a journey to the yaks' homeland to save Equestria's relations with them.

title: Amending Fences
summary: Amending Fences is the twelfth episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and third episode overall.
In this episode, Twilight Sparkle returns to Canterlot with Spike to rekindle old friendships from before her move to Ponyville.

title: Do Princesses Dream of Magic Sheep?
summary: Do Princesses Dream of Magic Sheep?[note 1] is the thirteenth episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and fourth episode overall. It marks season five's midseason finale. The title is a play on the 1968 science fiction novel Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? by Philip K. Dick.
In this episode, Princess Luna enlists the Mane Six to hunt down a magical force that turns dreams into nightmares.

title: Canterlot Boutique
summary: Canterlot Boutique is the fourteenth episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and fifth episode overall.
Rarity's dream of owning a boutique in Canterlot finally comes true, but it comes at a price she isn't sure she's willing to pay.

title: Rarity Investigates!
summary: Rarity Investigates! is the fifteenth episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and sixth episode overall.
In this parody of film noir, Rarity tries to prove Rainbow Dash innocent when she is accused of committing a crime.

title: Made in Manehattan
summary:
Made in Manehattan is the sixteenth episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and seventh episode overall. The title is a reference to the 2002 film Maid in Manhattan.
In this episode, Applejack and Rarity are called by the map to the city of Manehattan to help Coco Pommel on a big project.

This episode and Brotherhooves Social take place simultaneously, with the former focusing on Applejack and Rarity in Manehattan and the latter focusing on Big Mac replacing Applejack in the Sisterhooves Social.

title: Brotherhooves Social
summary:
Brotherhooves Social is the seventeenth episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and eighth episode overall. The title is a reference to the season two episode Sisterhooves Social.
Big Mac volunteers to be Apple Bloom's sister for the Sisterhooves Social while Applejack is out of town.

This episode and Made in Manehattan take place simultaneously, with the former focusing on Big Mac replacing Applejack in the Sisterhooves Social and the latter focusing on Applejack and Rarity who are called by the map to the city of Manehattan to help Coco Pommel on a big project.

title: Crusaders of the Lost Mark
summary: Crusaders of the Lost Mark is the eighteenth episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and ninth episode overall. The title is a reference to the 1981 Indiana Jones film Raiders of the Lost Ark.

In this episode, the Cutie Mark Crusaders discover another side to Diamond Tiara when they help Pipsqueak run for class president against her. It is the first episode to feature the Cutie Mark Crusaders with their cutie marks. It is also the third musical episode after Magical Mystery Cure and Pinkie Pride.

title: The One Where Pinkie Pie Knows
summary: The One Where Pinkie Pie Knows is the nineteenth episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and tenth episode overall. The episode title is modeled after the nondescript episode titles of the 1994 sitcom Friends.
In this episode, Pinkie Pie finds out Princess Cadance and Shining Armor are going to have a baby, but she finds it a difficult secret to keep from her friends.

title: Hearthbreakers
summary: Hearthbreakers is the twentieth episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and eleventh episode overall.
In this episode, the Apple family from Sweet Apple Acres witnesses a different kind of Hearth's Warming Eve with the Pie family.

title: Scare Master
summary:
Scare Master is the twenty-first episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and twelfth episode overall. The title is a parody of the season one episode Stare Master, which, in turn, is a reference of the exercise machine, the Stair Master.
In this episode, Fluttershy decides to face her fears and take part in Nightmare Night with her friends.

title: What About Discord?
summary: What About Discord? (titled What About Discord[1] by some sources) is the twenty-second episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and thirteenth episode overall. The title and plot are a parody of the 1991 comedy film What About Bob?
Twilight Sparkle returns from a three-day weekend and finds that her friends have become close to Discord, making her wonder if he is up to something.

title: The Hooffields and McColts
summary: The Hooffields and McColts is the twenty-third episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and fourteenth episode overall. The title and plot are a parody of the real-life feud between the Hatfield family and the McCoy family.
In this episode, Princess Twilight and Fluttershy are called by the map to settle a feud between two families who can't remember why they're fighting against each other.

title: The Mane Attraction
summary: The Mane Attraction is the twenty-fourth episode of the fifth season of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and fifteenth episode overall. It features a guest appearance by Tony Award-winning actress Lena Hall (Hedwig and the Angry Inch). The title is a play on the phrase "the main attraction".
An old friend of Applejack's, Coloratura, has become a huge pop star and Applejack fears that the singer's manager does not have her best interests at heart.

title: The Cutie Re-Mark - Part 1
summary:
The Cutie Re-Mark - Part 1, also formatted as The Cutie Re-Mark - Pt. 1 and The Cutie Re-Mark Part I,[1] is the twenty-fifth episode of season five of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and sixteenth overall. It is the first part of a two-part season finale. This episode and Part 2 take place simultaneously with My Little Pony Equestria Girls: Friendship Games.
In this episode, Starlight Glimmer returns for revenge against the Mane Six and casts a spell that changes the course of Equestria's history. Two events based on the episode-"Sombraverse" and "Sombraverse Redux"-were included in Gameloft's mobile game.

title: The Cutie Re-Mark - Part 2
summary:
The Cutie Re-Mark - Part 2, also formatted as The Cutie Re-Mark - Pt. 2 and The Cutie Re-Mark Part II,[1] is the twenty-sixth episode of season five of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and seventeenth overall. It is the second part of the season finale. This episode and Part 1 take place simultaneously with My Little Pony Equestria Girls: Friendship Games.
In this episode, Twilight Sparkle tries to stop Starlight Glimmer from changing history, but she fears her efforts may be in vain. Two events based on the episode-"Changelingverse" and "Lunaverse"-were included in Gameloft's mobile game, as was a follow-up event, "The Cutie THREE-Mark."

title: The Crystalling - Part 1
summary:
The Crystalling - Part 1 is the first episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and eighteenth overall, being the first episode to take place after the film My Little Pony Equestria Girls: Friendship Games. It is the first part of a two-part season premiere.
The Mane Six are introduced to Princess Cadance and Shining Armor's baby foal Flurry Heart, while Twilight Sparkle gives Starlight Glimmer her first friendship lesson.

title: The Crystalling - Part 2
summary: The Crystalling - Part 2 is the second episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and nineteenth overall. It is the second part of a two-part season premiere.
Eternal winter makes its way to the Crystal Empire while Starlight Glimmer struggles to reunite with her childhood friend.

title: The Gift of the Maud Pie
summary:
The Gift of the Maud Pie is the third episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and twentieth overall. The title and the events of the episode are a reference to O. Henry's short story The Gift of the Magi.
While Rarity looks for an ideal location in Manehattan for her new store, she helps Pinkie Pie find the perfect gift for her sister Maud.

title: On Your Marks
summary:
On Your Marks is the fourth episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and twenty-first overall. The title is a reference to "on your marks, get set, go", the expression used to start a race.
In this episode, the Cutie Mark Crusaders struggle with the question of what's next after receiving their cutie marks.

title: Gauntlet of Fire
summary:
Gauntlet of Fire is the fifth episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and twenty-second overall.
In this episode, Spike takes part in a perilous Gauntlet for the title of Dragon Lord in order to protect his friends.

title: No Second Prances
summary:
No Second Prances is the sixth episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and twenty-third overall. The title is a play on the common phrase "no second chances".
When Starlight Glimmer becomes friends with Trixie, Twilight Sparkle disapproves.

title: Newbie Dash
summary:
Newbie Dash is the seventh episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and twenty-fourth overall.
When Rainbow Dash makes a bad first impression after joining the Wonderbolts, she is saddled with a mortifying nickname.

title: A Hearth's Warming Tail
summary:
A Hearth's Warming Tail is the eighth episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and twenty-fifth overall. The title and plot both reference Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol.
When Starlight Glimmer comes down with the holiday blues, Princess Twilight tries to help by reading a Hearth's Warming story to her. This is the fourth musical episode after Magical Mystery Cure, Pinkie Pride, and Crusaders of the Lost Mark and the third Hearth's Warming-related episode after Hearth's Warming Eve and Hearthbreakers.

title: The Saddle Row Review
summary:
The Saddle Row Review, early title Saddle Row & Rec[1] used by some sources,[2] is the ninth episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and twenty-sixth overall.
When Rarity opens her flagship store in Manehattan, a tell-tale article threatens to expose how her friends almost ruined the grand opening.

title: Applejack's "Day" Off
summary:
Applejack's "Day" Off is the tenth episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and twenty-seventh overall.
In this episode, Rarity tries to get Applejack to relax at the Ponyville Day Spa while Twilight and Spike handle Applejack's chores for her.

title: Flutter Brutter
summary:
Flutter Brutter is the eleventh episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and twenty-eighth overall.
In this episode, Fluttershy tries to convince her freeloading brother Zephyr Breeze to move out of their parents' house, causing him to move in with her instead.

title: Spice Up Your Life
summary:
Spice Up Your Life is the twelfth episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and twenty-ninth overall. It marks season six's midseason finale. The title is a reference to the Spice Girls song of the same name.[1]
In this episode, Rarity and Pinkie Pie are called to Canterlot by the Cutie Map to help a struggling father-daughter family restaurant.

title: Stranger Than Fan Fiction
summary:
Stranger Than Fan Fiction is the thirteenth episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and thirtieth overall. The title is a reference to the saying "truth is stranger than fiction" and fan fiction, an in-universe example of the latter of which is Untitled Mare Do Well fanfiction.
In this episode, Rainbow Dash attends a Daring Do Convention and meets Quibble Pants, who hates Daring Do's post-book three stories as much as she loves them.

title: The Cart Before the Ponies
summary:
The Cart Before the Ponies is the fourteenth episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and thirty-first overall. The title is a reference to the idiom "putting the cart before the horse".
When the Cutie Mark Crusaders enter the annual Applewood Derby, their teammates, Applejack, Rarity, and Rainbow Dash take over the competition.

title: 28 Pranks Later
summary:
28 Pranks Later is the fifteenth episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and thirty-second overall. The title and the events of the episode are a reference to the 28 Days Later film series.
In this episode, Rainbow Dash's pranking gets out of hand, so the other ponies decide to give her a taste of her own medicine.

title: The Times They Are A Changeling
summary:
The Times They Are A Changeling is the sixteenth episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and thirty-third overall. The title might be a reference to the 1964 Bob Dylan album "The Times They are a-Changin'", basis of Enterplay collectible card game Marks in Time #102 C card Invasion of the Changelings flavor text "The times, they are a'changelin'."
In this episode, Twilight Sparkle, Starlight Glimmer, and Spike travel to the Crystal Empire and find the Crystal Ponies in a panic over the possibility of a changeling spy.

title: Dungeons & Discords
summary:
Dungeons & Discords, also called Dungeons and Discords,[1] is the seventeenth episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and thirty-fourth overall. The title is a reference to Hasbro's Wizards of the Coast tabletop role-playing game Dungeons & Dragons, which has been partnered with through merchandise[2][3] and has had two in-universe counterparts—Oubliettes & Ogres and Dragons & Dragons—introduced in the IDW comics.
When the Mane Six leave town, Discord joins Spike and Big McIntosh's top-secret "Guys' Night" of fantasy role-playing.

title: Buckball Season
summary:
Buckball Season is the eighteenth episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and thirty-fifth overall. The title is similar to the season one episode Applebuck Season.
In this episode, Applejack and Rainbow Dash train Fluttershy and Pinkie Pie for an upcoming buckball game against Appleloosa.

title: The Fault in Our Cutie Marks
summary:
The Fault in Our Cutie Marks is the nineteenth episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and thirty-sixth overall. The title is a reference to the John Green novel The Fault in Our Stars.
In this episode, a young griffon named Gabby asks the Cutie Mark Crusaders to help her get her own cutie mark.

title: Viva Las Pegasus
summary:
Viva Las Pegasus is the twentieth episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and thirty-seventh overall. The title is a reference to the tourist slogan "Viva Las Vegas", made popular by the 1964 film of the same name.
Applejack and Fluttershy are summoned to Las Pegasus by the Cutie Map to investigate suspicious goings-on at Gladmane's resort.
An event inspired by the episode, "Viva La Pinkie Pie" was included in Gameloft's mobile game.

title: Every Little Thing She Does
summary:
Every Little Thing She Does is the twenty-first episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and thirty-eighth overall. The title is a reference to the 1981 Police song "Every Little Thing She Does Is Magic" and/or the 1964 Beatles song "Every Little Thing".
In this episode, Starlight Glimmer tries to impress Princess Twilight by taking on multiple friendship problems at once.

title: P.P.O.V. (Pony Point of View)
summary:
P.P.O.V. (Pony Point of View) is the twenty-second episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and thirty-ninth overall.
In this Rashomon-style episode, Twilight Sparkle must discern the truth after Applejack, Rarity, and Pinkie Pie return from a boat trip angry at each other and with three different versions of the trip's events.

title: Where the Apple Lies
summary:
Where the Apple Lies is the twenty-third episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and fortieth overall. The title is a reference to the 2003 novel and 2005 film Where the Truth Lies.
In this episode, Applejack shares the embarrassing story of how she came to value honesty after her lies almost jeopardized the farm's livelihood.

title: Top Bolt
summary:
Top Bolt is the twenty-fourth episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and forty-first overall. The title is a reference to the 1986 Tom Cruise film Top Gun.
In this episode, Twilight Sparkle and Rainbow Dash are called to the Wonderbolt Academy by the Cutie Map to help academy hopefuls Sky Stinger and Vapor Trail with a friendship problem.

title: To Where and Back Again - Part 1
summary:
To Where and Back Again - Part 1, also formatted as To Where and Back Again: Part 1[1] and To Where and Back Again Pt. 1,[2][3] is the twenty-fifth episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and forty-second overall. It is the first part of a two-part season finale. The title is a reference to the subtitle of the J.R.R. Tolkien novel The Hobbit, or There and Back Again.
In this first part, Starlight Glimmer discovers a plot by one of Equestria's oldest and greatest threats and must assemble an unlikely team of heroes to save her friends.

title: To Where and Back Again - Part 2
summary:
To Where and Back Again - Part 2, also formatted as To Where and Back Again: Part 2 and To Where and Back Again Pt. 2,[1][2] is the twenty-sixth episode of season six of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and forty-third overall. It is the second part of a two-part season finale.
In this second part, Starlight Glimmer leads an unlikely squad of heroes against Queen Chrysalis and the changelings to save her friends and all of Equestria.

title: Celestial Advice
summary:
Celestial Advice is the first episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and forty-fourth overall. Notably, this is the only season premiere to not be a two-part episode.
In this premiere, Twilight Sparkle agonizes over Starlight Glimmer's future and seeks advice from Princess Celestia.

title: All Bottled Up
summary:
All Bottled Up is the second episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and forty-fifth overall. Notably, this is the only season premiere to not be a two-part episode.
In this episode, Starlight Glimmer and Trixie accidentally make the Cutie Map disappear while the Mane Six are on a friendship retreat, so Starlight uses a spell to bottle up her anger until the map is retrieved.

title: A Flurry of Emotions
summary:
A Flurry of Emotions is the third episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and forty-sixth overall.
In this episode, Twilight Sparkle agrees to babysit her niece Flurry Heart despite already having a very busy schedule.

title: Rock Solid Friendship
summary:
Rock Solid Friendship is the fourth episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and forty-seventh overall.
In this episode, Maud Pie considers moving to Ponyville after graduating from geology school, and Pinkie Pie tries to help her see that the town has more to offer than just rocks.

title: Fluttershy Leans In
summary:
Fluttershy Leans In is the fifth episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and forty-eighth overall.
In this episode, Fluttershy tries to stand up for her ideas in order to realize her dream of building an animal sanctuary.

title: Forever Filly
summary:
Forever Filly is the sixth episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and forty-ninth overall. The title is a play on the expression "forever young", which is frequently used in film, television, and music.
In this episode, Rarity attempts to spend quality time with Sweetie Belle, unaware that she's not a little filly anymore. Meanwhile, Apple Bloom and Scootaloo attempt to help Zipporwhill reconnect with her pet dog Ripley.

title: Parental Glideance
summary:
Parental Glideance is the seventh episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and fiftieth overall. The title is a pun on "parental guidance".
In this episode, Rainbow Dash's parents discover she's a Wonderbolt and start showing up at every event to cheer her on. However, their unbridled enthusiasm embarrasses Rainbow and pushes her to the brink.

title: Hard to Say Anything
summary:
Hard to Say Anything is the eighth episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and fifty-first overall. The title is a reference to the 1989 film Say Anything..., the same basis as Neigh Anything's title and My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic Issue #11 Hot Topic cover.
When Big McIntosh develops a crush on Sugar Belle, the Cutie Mark Crusaders try to help him win her heart before rivaling stallion Feather Bangs does.

title: Honest Apple
summary:
Honest Apple is the ninth episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic[1][2] and the one hundred and fifty-second overall.
When Rarity asks Applejack to be a judge in a fashion show, Applejack learns that an opinion, however honest, can still be hurtful.

title: A Royal Problem
summary:
A Royal Problem is the tenth episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and fifty-third overall.
In this episode, Starlight Glimmer is sent by the Cutie Map to solve a friendship problem between Princess Celestia and Princess Luna, which she attempts to do by impulsively switching their cutie marks.

title: Not Asking for Trouble
summary:
Not Asking for Trouble is the eleventh episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and fifty-fourth overall. It marks season seven's midseason finale.[1]
In this episode, an avalanche falls on Yakyakistan, and Pinkie Pie tries to convince Prince Rutherford and the proud yaks to ask the ponies for help.

title: Discordant Harmony
summary:
Discordant Harmony is the twelfth episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and fifty-fifth overall.
In this episode, Discord invites Fluttershy to his realm for tea, but he worries she won't be comfortable there and begins to change it—and himself.

title: The Perfect Pear
summary:
The Perfect Pear is the thirteenth episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and fifty-sixth overall. The title is a play on the expression "the perfect pair".
In this episode, Applejack, Apple Bloom, and Big McIntosh learn about their parents' love story and discover that they are half-Pear.
An event based on the episode was included in Gameloft's mobile game.

title: Fame and Misfortune
summary:
Fame and Misfortune is the fourteenth episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and fifty-seventh overall.
When Twilight Sparkle publishes her and her friends' friendship journal, it has unintended consequences when ponies start to argue over who wrote the best lessons.

title: Triple Threat
summary:
Triple Threat is the fifteenth episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and fifty-eighth overall.
When Spike accidentally invites Ember and Thorax to Ponyville on the same day, he believes they won't get along and tries to keep them apart.

title: Campfire Tales
summary:
Campfire Tales is the sixteenth episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and fifty-ninth overall.
In this episode, Applejack, Rarity, and Rainbow Dash tell Apple Bloom, Sweetie Belle, and Scootaloo about their favorite legends after their camping trip is ruined by Fly-ders.

title: To Change a Changeling
summary:
To Change a Changeling is the seventeenth episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and sixtieth overall.
In this episode, Starlight Glimmer and Trixie try to get Thorax's brother Pharynx to accept the changelings' new way of sharing love.

title: Daring Done?
summary:
Daring Done? is the eighteenth episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and sixty-first overall.
In this episode, Rainbow Dash and Pinkie Pie go on a mission to find out if A. K. Yearling is retiring from writing books.

title: It Isn't the Mane Thing About You
summary:
It Isn't the Mane Thing About You is the nineteenth episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and sixty-second overall.
In this episode, Rarity's shampoo is accidentally switched with Zecora's magical remover potion, and she must fix her devastated mane in time for an upcoming photo shoot.

title: A Health of Information
summary:
A Health of Information is the twentieth episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and sixty-third overall. The title is a play on the expression "a wealth of information".
In this episode, Zecora comes down with Swamp Fever, a disease for which no cure has been discovered, and Fluttershy makes it her mission to heal her.

title: Marks and Recreation
summary:
Marks and Recreation is the twenty-first episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and sixty-fourth overall. The title is a play on the NBC sitcom Parks and Recreation, which was previously spoofed as the working title of The Saddle Row Review ("Saddle Row & Rec").
In this episode, the Cutie Mark Crusaders start a Cutie Mark Day Camp only to find out that one of their campers doesn't want a cutie mark.

title: Once Upon a Zeppelin
summary:
Once Upon a Zeppelin[note 1] is the twenty-second episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and sixty-fifth overall.
In this episode, Twilight Sparkle and her family's cruise vacation is actually a themed vacation where ponies have paid for the privilege of spending time with her, and she must please both her family and the cruise attendees.

title: Secrets and Pies
summary:
Secrets and Pies is the twenty-third episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and sixty-sixth overall. The title is a play on the phrase "secrets and lies", which is spoken by Pinkie Pie in Party of One.
In this episode, Pinkie Pie thinks she sees Rainbow Dash throw one of her pies away and suspects that Rainbow secretly hates her pies, so she attempts to catch Rainbow in her web of lies.

title: Uncommon Bond
summary:
Uncommon Bond is the twenty-fourth episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and sixty-seventh overall.[1] The title is a play on the phrase "common bond".
In this episode, Starlight Glimmer gets a visit from Sunburst and discovers he has a lot in common with her friends, causing her to wonder if he still has anything in common with her.

title: Shadow Play - Part 1
summary:
Shadow Play - Part 1 is the twenty-fifth episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and sixty-eighth overall. It is the first part of a two-part season finale.
In this first part, Sunburst discovers Star Swirl the Bearded's lost journal, and Twilight Sparkle becomes obsessed with saving him from a thousand-year-old prison.

title: Shadow Play - Part 2
summary:
Shadow Play - Part 2 is the twenty-sixth episode of season seven of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic, the one hundred and sixty-ninth overall, and the last to take place before My Little Pony The Movie. It is the second part of a two-part season finale.
In this second part, Star Swirl the Bearded and the other Pillars of Old Equestria are back from limbo, and Twilight Sparkle and her friends must work with them to defeat the Pony of Shadows.

title: School Daze - Part 1
summary:
School Daze - Part 1 is the first episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and seventieth overall, being the first episode to take place after My Little Pony The Movie. It is the first part of a two-part season premiere.
In this first part, Twilight Sparkle decides to open a School of Friendship when the Cutie Map grows bigger to reflect the world beyond Equestria.

title: School Daze - Part 2
summary:
School Daze - Part 2 is the second episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and seventy-first overall. It is the second part of a two-part season premiere.
In this second part, Twilight Sparkle and her students try to save the School of Friendship from being shut down by the Equestria Educational Association.

title: The Maud Couple
summary: The Maud Couple is the third episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and seventy-second overall. The title is a reference to the Neil Simon play The Odd Couple, as well as its subsequent film and television adaptations.
In this episode, Pinkie Pie's super-best-friend-sister bond with Maud is challenged when Maud gets a boyfriend that Pinkie can't stand.

title: Fake It 'Til You Make It
summary:
Fake It 'Til You Make It[note 1] is the fourth episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and seventy-third overall.
When Fluttershy looks after Rarity's Manehattan boutique, she takes on a series of characters to cope with the intimidating clientele.

title: Grannies Gone Wild
summary:
Grannies Gone Wild is the fifth episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and seventy-fourth overall. The title is a reference to the since-ended explicit video series Girls Gone Wild.
In this episode, Granny Smith and her friends head to Las Pegasus, and Rainbow Dash tags along as their chaperone so she can ride the best rollercoaster ever before it closes.

title: Surf and/or Turf
summary:
Surf and/or Turf is the sixth episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and seventy-fifth overall. The title is a play on the phrase "surf and turf".
In this episode, the Cutie Mark Crusaders get sent by the Cutie Map to Mount Aris to help a young Hippogriff figure out where he belongs.

title: Horse Play
summary:
Horse Play is the seventh episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and seventy-sixth overall. The title is a play on horseplay, referring to rough or boisterous playing.
In this episode, Twilight Sparkle casts Princess Celestia in her stage play, only to discover that Celestia's talents lie elsewhere.

title: The Parent Map
summary:
The Parent Map is the eighth episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and seventy-seventh overall. The title is a play on the film series The Parent Trap.
In this episode, the Cutie Map sends Starlight Glimmer and Sunburst to their hometown of Sire's Hollow to solve a friendship problem with their parents.

title: Non-Compete Clause
summary: Non-Compete Clause is the ninth episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and seventy-eighth overall. The title is in reference to a legality in contract law.
In this episode, Applejack and Rainbow Dash take their friendship students on a teamwork learning field trip and accidentally show the students how to not work together.

title: The Break Up Break Down
summary:
The Break Up Break Down is the tenth episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and seventy-ninth overall.
In this episode, Big McIntosh has romantic plans for Sugar Belle on Hearts and Hooves Day, but he overhears her tell Mrs. Cake she's planning to break up with him. Meanwhile, the Cutie Mark Crusaders try to find out who Sweetie Belle's "secret admirer" could be.

title: Molt Down
summary:
Molt Down is the eleventh episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and eightieth overall. The title is a play on the word "meltdown".
In this episode, Spike undergoes a developmental stage for dragons called the "molt", and according to Smolder, its side effects compel a molter's family to kick them out of the house.

title: Marks for Effort
summary:
Marks for Effort is the twelfth episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and eighty-first overall.
In this episode, the Cutie Mark Crusaders try to convince Twilight Sparkle to let them into the School of Friendship, even though it's clear they've already mastered the curriculum.

title: The Mean 6
summary:
The Mean 6 is the thirteenth episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and eighty-second overall. It marks season eight's midseason finale. The title is a play on "the Mane 6", the term used to collectively refer to the series' six pony main characters.
In this episode, Queen Chrysalis returns to exact her revenge on Starlight Glimmer and the Mane Six.

title: A Matter of Principals
summary:
A Matter of Principals is the fourteenth episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and eighty-third overall. The title is a wordplay on the phrase "matter of principles".
When Twilight Sparkle leaves Starlight Glimmer in charge of the School of Friendship, Discord gets frustrated and does his best to make Starlight's role impossible.

title: The Hearth's Warming Club
summary:
The Hearth's Warming Club is the fifteenth episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and eighty-fourth overall. The title and concept is a reference to the John Hughes film The Breakfast Club.
In this episode, a prank gone wrong ruins Hearth's Warming Eve preparations, and while Twilight Sparkle tries to figure out which of her students is behind it, the students bond over shared memories of home. This is the fourth Hearth's Warming-related episode after Hearth's Warming Eve, Hearthbreakers, and A Hearth's Warming Tail.

title: Friendship University
summary:
Friendship University is the sixteenth episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and eighty-fifth overall.
When Twilight Sparkle discovers there's another School of Friendship, she and Rarity go to investigate and are shocked to discover that Twilight's idol and Pillar of Old Equestria, Star Swirl the Bearded, is enrolled at the school.

title: The End in Friend
summary:
The End in Friend is the seventeenth episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and eighty-sixth overall.
In this episode, Rarity and Rainbow Dash begin to question why they are friends when they can't find anything they both like to do together.

title: Yakity-Sax
summary:
Yakity-Sax is the eighteenth episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and eighty-seventh overall. The title is a reference to the Boots Randolph song of a similar name, later recognized as the theme for The Benny Hill Show, which was parodied earlier in The Ticket Master and A Bird in the Hoof.
In this episode, Pinkie Pie picks up playing a bizarre instrument as a new hobby, but her friends get annoyed by her inability to play it.

title: Road to Friendship
summary:
Road to Friendship, titled On the Road to Friendship by some sources, is the nineteenth episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and eighty-eighth overall.
In this episode, Trixie is invited to bring her magic show to Saddle Arabia, and she can think of no one better to bring along than her great and powerful assistant Starlight Glimmer.

title: The Washouts
summary:
The Washouts is the twentieth episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and eighty-ninth overall.
In this episode, Scootaloo becomes enamored with the Washouts, a touring group of stunt ponies, and Rainbow Dash is concerned for her safety and worries that Scootaloo's days as her number one fan are over.

title: A Rockhoof and a Hard Place
summary:
A Rockhoof and a Hard Place is the twenty-first episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and ninetieth overall. The episode title is a play on the expression "between a rock and a hard place".
When Rockhoof, one of the Pillars of Old Equestria, has trouble fitting into the modern world, Twilight Sparkle and her friends try to help him find a new purpose.

title: What Lies Beneath
summary:
What Lies Beneath is the twenty-second episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and ninety-first overall.
In this episode, the Young Six cram for Twilight Sparkle's "History of Magic in Equestria" exam when they discover a part of the School of Friendship that no one else knows about.

title: Sounds of Silence
summary:
Sounds of Silence, titled Sound of Silence by Boomerang TV listings on Foxtel, is the twenty-third episode of season eight of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic and the one hundred and ninety-second overall. The title is a reference to the 1964 Simon & Garfunkel song "The Sound of Silence" and/or their 1966 studio album Sounds of Silence.
